events.title: Assassination of Thomas Becket
events.description: Archbishop of Canterbury Thomas Becket was murdered inside Canterbury Cathedral by four knights loyal to King Henry II, following a long dispute between the Church and the Crown over clerical privileges.
events.significance: The killing shocked medieval Christendom, led to Becket's canonization in 1173, and forced Henry II to do public penance. Canterbury became one of Europe's major pilgrimage sites.

events.title: Texas Admitted as the 28th U.S. State
events.description: President James K. Polk signed the joint resolution admitting the Republic of Texas into the United States as a slave state.
events.significance: Annexation heightened tensions with Mexico and helped precipitate the Mexican-American War (1846-1848), while intensifying the national debate over the expansion of slavery.

events.title: Wounded Knee Massacre
events.description: U.S. Army troops of the 7th Cavalry killed an estimated 250 to 300 Lakota Sioux, many of them women and children, at Wounded Knee Creek in South Dakota.
events.significance: Often considered the last major armed confrontation of the Indian Wars, it became a lasting symbol of the violent dispossession of Native Americans.

events.title: Irish Constitution Takes Effect
events.description: The Constitution of Ireland (Bunreacht na hÉireann), approved by plebiscite in July 1937, came into force, replacing the Irish Free State constitution and establishing the state named Ireland (Éire).
events.significance: It established the framework of modern Irish government, including the office of President, and marked a major step in Ireland's constitutional separation from the British Crown.

events.title: Eastern Air Lines Flight 401 Crashes in the Florida Everglades
events.description: A Lockheed L-1011 TriStar crashed after the flight crew became preoccupied with a burned-out landing gear indicator light and failed to notice the autopilot had disengaged, killing 101 people.
events.significance: The accident became a landmark case in aviation safety and led to the development of Crew Resource Management training, emphasizing communication and task prioritization in the cockpit.
